release_title: Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) Master Release Manifest

provenance_chain.explanation: Preserves immutable provenance across staged milestones: 68575eaa established the failing control matrix; bd0d845b introduced the AEIB boundary and positive/negative trial manifests; f1ff34fb anchored ground truth to an on-disk binary SQLite database (ledger.db) and adversarial anti-fabrication suite. The verifier was subsequently hardened for release at c9b239bb and beyond. The tag v0.2.2 encapsulates all finalized benchmark and paper revisions.

formal_invariants.safety: LedgerCommits(I) <= 1 for any logical intent I
formal_invariants.liveness: State(I) reaches terminal resolution in {OUTCOME_VERIFIED, RECONCILIATION_NOT_FOUND} without deadlock

test_suite_composition.note: Extends the previously reported 15-test baseline (6 control matrix + 9 eBPF) with 5 dedicated adversarial falsifiability proofs in test_falsifiability.py.

c2_gateway_semantic_drift.resolution: Duplicate ledger commit due to cache miss (Safety failed)

aeib_post_commit_504.verification_rate: 50/50 (All 50 receipts in tested sample independently verified)
aeib_post_commit_504.resolution: Authoritative probe and signed receipt (Safety held)

scope_and_qualification.boundary_condition_c1: Conventional gateway idempotency successfully deduplicates requests when the retry preserves the exact deduplication identity and request bytes (0/50 duplicates in C1).
scope_and_qualification.semantic_drift_model_c2: C0 and C2 demonstrate failure under the benchmark's specific semantic-drift model; they characterize the tested implementation and fault model, but do not establish that all LLM agents or all gateways behave identically.
scope_and_qualification.regulatory_qualification: DORA Article 17 and EU AI Act Article 14 motivate the need for durable operational evidence; this work makes no compliance or certification claim.
scope_and_qualification.universal_safety_disclaimer: AEIB results are bounded by the tested local harness and do not establish production-wide or universal exactly-once guarantees.
